title: MV [FREE] Need Help Polishing a House Corridor Map ( RPG Maker MV )

posts.author: yqern33
posts.body:
View attachment 342118
Hello, I'm working on a 30x30 house corridor map for RPG Maker MV.
Only a small portion of the map will actually be used — the rest is intentionally left black since it's outside the playable area.
My tilesets are ready, but the visible part currently looks quite amateurish and could use some improvement.
I'm trying to make the map look more polished and atmospheric, and I would truly appreciate any free or small-scale help.
I'm working on this project by myself, and even a bit of visual support would really help me move forward.
Thank you so much in advance!
